tha-ap220:1.1: Akkantasaññaka.] Kusāṭakaṃ gahetvāna upajjhāyass' ahaṃ pure / mantañ ca anusikkhāmi kaṇḍabhedassa pattiyā. // //
tha-ap220:2.1: Addasaṃ virajaṃ Buddham āhutīnaṃ paṭiggahaṃ / usabhaṃ pavaram aggaṃ Tissabuddhagajuttamaṃ. // //
tha-ap220:3.1: Kusāṭakaṃ pattharitam akkamantaṃ naruttamaṃ / samuggataṃ mahāvīraṃ lokajeṭṭhaṃ narāsabhaṃ // //
tha-ap220:4.1: Disvā taṃ lokapajjotaṃ vimalaṃ candasannibhaṃ / avandiṃ satthuno pāde vippasannena cetasā. // //
tha-ap220:5.1: Catunavute ito kappe yam adāsiṃ kusāṭakaṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi kusāṭakass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap220:6.1: Sattatiṃse ito kappe eko āsi janādhipo / Sunando nāma nāmena cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap220:8.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Akkantasaññako thero i. g. a-ti.
